## douyinvideo2text-ai v0.1.0 Changelog

- Initial release of the skill for converting videos (Douyin, Xiaohongshu, or local files) into clean, structured text and copywriting.
- Supports video transcription, summary, rewriting, quote extraction, script breakdown, and translation using customizable prompts.
- Calls the Qwen large language model for semantic understanding and cleans up filler words, speech errors, and duplicate content.
- Command-line tool with parameters for video file/link, previous task reuse, custom prompts, and error handling.
- Secure and privacy-aware: processes only specified files, communicates only with the designated API, and auto-deletes source files post-processing.
- Includes example commands and detailed documentation for use cases such as meeting minutes, content repurposing, and creative writing.
